# Cloud recipe fixture

`cloud-mate-film.json` was retrieved on 2026-10-25 from the public detail endpoint used by Nikon's website:

https://imagingcloud.nikon.com/recipe/release/detail/?id=01M4SD0T78RAGG39JAVXRDR2X0

It is a reduced response retaining the ID, display names, Picture Control values and shooting reference metadata. Media URLs, author prose, account state and navigation data are omitted. No authentication was needed. It is **not an NP3 file** and does not contain the curve represented by `gamma` or the complete Flexible Color data. Tests must not claim that this fixture proves faithful rendering or camera compatibility.
